name: popsicle
headline: letthemlive: Instagram Automation with AutoGPT
short_description: Autonomous Instagram automation tool that uses AutoGPT and LangChain to generate and send direct messages, engage in conversations, and interact with target users.
author: Louvivien

sections.overview:
Let Them Live is a social media automation platform that enables Instagram accounts to operate autonomously using AutoGPT and LangChain. The system logs into Instagram, identifies target users, and automates direct messaging and conversation workflows. It can engage in conversations, follow users based on topics, and post comments. The tool includes both a Python server backend and a Node.js client frontend, with support for Redis caching and integration with OpenAI and Hugging Face APIs. It's designed for developers and teams looking to automate Instagram account management and user engagement at scale.
Autonomous Instagram account management and user engagement
Automated direct messaging campaigns to target users
Topic-based user discovery and follow automation
AI-powered comment generation on Instagram posts
